newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria executes six armed robbers.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria executes six armed robbers.

text.p: Six convicted armed robbers were on Thursday executed by firing squad in the eastern town of Umuahia, a local newspaper reported on Friday.
The independent Vanguard newspaper said the six had been on death row for 18 years.
Nigeria publicly executes armed robbers but delays are common because any death sentence is subject to confirmation by the governor of the state where the crime was committed.
